title: CMV Immunity Monitoring in Lung Transplant Recipients
official: Cytomegalovirus T Cell Immunity and Antiviral Prophylaxis Minimization in Lung Transplant Recipients
summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the safety and feasibility of using a laboratory test to guide duration of antiviral prophylaxis with valganciclovir (medication used to prevent viral infections) after lung transplant. The laboratory test, inSIGHT™ CMV T Cell Immunity Panel, measures patients' immune response to a common viral infection known as cytomegalovirus (CMV). The goal of this study will be to safely decrease how long patients need to take valganciclovir based on the results of the CMV T Cell Immunity Panel.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Received a lung transplant, or multi-organ transplant involving a lung at NYU Langone Health
2. Pre-existing serological immunity to CMV (R+)
3. Able and willing to provide informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Anti-thymocyte globulin induction immunosuppression
2. Perioperative desensitization
3. Pregnant or breastfeeding women
